subject: Malaysia M-510 TiO2 for Cantillana's Limelook review
body:
Cantillana's Limelook is offered as a mineral finish and lime paint.

We manufacture Malaysia-origin M-510 rutile TiO2. Its TDS lists water-based wall latex paints and zirconium/aluminium surface treatment; compatibility with a lime-based formulation would need technical assessment.

Could you route this enquiry to the team reviewing pigments for Limelook, so I can provide the M-510 technical sheet?
